name: R110-roar-drags-wounded-onto-spikes
why: Challenge 4. The opponent's Skarmory (482: Spikes, Roar, Drill Peck, Toxic) is faster than the player's slow Snorlax (556), Wailord (525) and Steelix (529). After it lays Spikes a Roar drags a wounded partner onto them and it faints with a Pokemon left (reduceFactoryFullTurnDecision). The player plays random legal actions.
